payload.body: GO, hv decision 23 (25 Nov). Your 4 defects, filed and fixed in a worktree: mdagg --strip-front-matter cuts any --- block, not only one at line 1; macoz setpicfor parses --pattern and never uses it, and its --dry-run still needs fileicon; prez.yaml says stdin input and "comrak is the only crate"; prez's USAGE omits present -o. With them, the "Personal use" line in the expz, macoz, mdagg, pdf2md and xtrct READMEs, since LICENSE is MIT (ST0019 WP-04; dc's finding). Your Desk asks, with their drivers' paths, go to devbin-vc and vc. Leave CHANGELOG.md alone: put your lines in your READY, and vc passes them to dc. Next: second reader on cc's arngz design when cc sends it. STb8e4fb6's AC .8 waits for hv's phone scan, and todo 13 stands.
